capture.calibration: 0.5-regime pass prob 0.0193; 0.95-regime flip 0.0196; a true 0.9 mechanism under-credits with p~0.11 (conservative direction); separating 0.5 from 0.9 needs n=13 (recorded, not available)

false_promotion.scope: any model-created loop state stronger than candidate, ever

confirmation_burden.calibration: quiet regime (lambda 0.3) passes 1.0; noisy regime (lambda 2.0) passes 0.0003

carriage.bar: active/reopened present; candidate/closed/dismissed/wrong-project absent; overflow names ids+count; crowd-out resistant; distill re-attachment verbatim

use.design: 4 worlds (2 interruption shapes x 2 projects), crossed arms with_loop/without_loop, stratified permutation test on the pooled mean difference
use.calibration: power 0.953 at (0.25 vs 0.9) regimes, null FPR 0.01 (300 sims, MC se ~0.012)

stale_resurrection.bar: closed/dismissed absent from checkpoints; kernel suppresses candidate re-proposal against terminal loops; behavioral spot-check on closure_mask worlds

capture_rules.matching: candidate covers a plant iff every match term is a substring of the normalized candidate text (fixtures.py, frozen)
capture_rules.prompt_tuning: calibration split only; held-out evaluated once
capture_rules.identical_pair: certainty asserted on either element fails; candidate/uncertainty/silence passes

use_world_rules.with_arm: fixture dialogue + one operator loop add at the acknowledgment moment + deterministic filler + noise notes + cutoff
use_world_rules.without_arm: identical world minus the loop add (the operator never externalized it) - the measured counterfactual
use_world_rules.task_hint: fixed per world, chosen to NOT overlap loop wording
use_world_rules.carriage_precondition: the with-arm package must mechanically contain the loop text before any model run; abort as invalid otherwise
use_world_rules.no_curation: filler and noise are generated by fixed seed and shared byte-identically between arms up to the loop-add event

verdict_rule.operator_trial: either capture verdict additionally requires the preregistered real-operator protocol with unseen wording/timing; machine-side results alone cap the verdict at NOT EARNED
verdict_rule.separation: capture, false promotion, burden, lifecycle, carriage, use, resurrection reported separately, never one score
